messages.text: Good morning Mr. Barrington — the sideboard carcass is glued up and square.
Wonderful news. The family is excited to see it.
Veneer work begins next week; photos to follow.
Mrs. Renard-Whitcomb here: are the chair seats carved yet?
Seat blanks are milled; carving starts Saturday.
Wesley: your lumber order arrived at the yard, dock 3.
Much obliged — I'll collect it Tuesday morning.
Ellis: the rock maple quote is ready when you are.
Hi Sunniva, can I swap my Wednesday afternoon shift for the morning?
Yes, done - you're on cloakroom 8am to 12 on Wednesday now.
Do volunteers get lunch on the load-in day too?
Bacon or veggie rolls at 9 and pizza at 1 for the load-in crew.
Perfect, thank you!
Hi Callum, your T-shirt is size L and will be in your volunteer bag at the briefing.
Is the briefing recorded? I can't make the 23rd.
It isn't, but I'll do a 15-minute call with you on the 22nd instead.
Thanks, the 22nd works

Good morning, Harbour Inn reservations here. Your cancellation of booking HR-A2EB-76 (arrival 24 November) reached us at nine this morning and is confirmed; the room is back in our inventory. Our back office will add it to the cancellation log in the next few days.
Thanks, I'll pass that to Tomasz in finance.
Hi Sunniva, where do I park on the load-in day?
Loading bay car park behind the Exchange Hall, show your volunteer pass at the barrier.
Brilliant, thanks
Can my partner come to the thank-you drinks?
I've lost my briefing email, what time is it again?
6pm on Monday 23 November in the Exchange Hall foyer.
Got it
Reminder: bring flat shoes for the stage crew shift.
Do I need my own hi-vis for the car park shift?
No, the team lead hands them out at the start of each shift.
Ok great
Running 10 mins late tomorrow, sorry
